heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 119–101, title I, § 107(c)(2), July 11, 2026, 140 Stat. 859

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 102–550, title XII, § 1205, Oct. 28, 1992, 106 Stat. 3940; Pub. L. 106–569, title I, § 103, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2947, established a clearinghouse to serve as a national repository to receive, collect, process, assemble, and disseminate information relating to regulatory barriers to affordable housing.
